description:
Talk about an American beauty! It doesn't get any more authentic than this. The classic Worksman Cruiser you'll see all over the streets of New York City. Design your very own women's cruiser today.

The base model is a standard Worksman Step Through or Unisex frame Cruiser (Same as our legendary Industrial Strength Models), with our heavy duty clincher rims, 11 gauge spokes, Shimano E110 Coaster Brake, WTC Blackwall Sup-r-tires, no fenders, 24" handlebar, comfortable padded seat, heavy duty 1/2 x 3/16" chain and sprocket and is a great bike just the way it is. A Real Classic American Made Cruiser Bike, more durable than any other brand. See photos of our Custom Order Options HERE.
